retention.duration: Retain only derived report artifacts and source hashes; do not persist raw OHLCV response payloads.

attribution.format: Market data source: Binance Spot public market-data API, https://developers.binance.com/en/docs/products/spot/rest-api

automated_access.request_window_scope: Only the explicitly declared historical windows for the event-to-movement review.

limitations: Internal descriptive research only; no public redistribution of raw market data.
The API documentation establishes the public endpoint but does not itself provide a blanket legal opinion about data ownership.
Raw OHLCV response bodies may exist transiently in process memory for hashing and analysis but must not be written to disk or artifacts.
Derived movement episodes are exploratory and inherit the experimental status of configs/technical-descriptive-baseline.json.
Temporal association is not causality; event capture occurred after the historical movement and therefore cannot be treated as point-in-time knowledge.
